basic_details.job_title: IGKV Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Manager, Assistant Grade III Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV) has announced 3 contract vacancies for Manager (Project) and Assistant Grade -III posts. Candidates can apply offline by sending the filled application form through Speed post, Registered post, or by hand to The Director of Research, Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya Krishak Nagar, Jora, Raipur (Chhattisgarh) on or before 21 October 2026. Qualifications required are a Post graduate in Bio technology from recognized University/Institute for Manager (Project) and Higher Secondary with 1 Year Diploma in Computer Application for Assistant Grade -III.

qualification.details: Manager (Project) Eligibility: Post graduate in Bio technology from recognized University/Institute. Three years of relevant work experience in handing biotechnology infrastructure Project. Maximum age limit not exceeding 35 years (40 years for Chhattisgarh bonafide resident). | Assistant Grade -III Eligibility: Higher Secondary with 1 Year Diploma in Computer Application. Maximum age limit not exceeding 35 years (40 years for Chhattisgarh bonafide resident).

selection_process: Selection is based on a scorecard system for recruitment which includes points for educational qualifications
and a personal interview or computer skill test/typing test.

rows.details: Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV) / Chhattisgarh Biotechnology Promotion Society
Post graduate in Bio technology / Higher Secondary with Diploma in Computer Application

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Application forms should be sent to the following address: The Director of Research,Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya,Krishak Nagar, Jora, Raipur (Chhattisgarh) 492 012 Applications can be submitted by Speed post, Registered post, or by hand. Application form submitted to any other address will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Manager (Project) Eligibility: Post graduate in Bio technology from recognized University/Institute. Three years of relevant work experience in handing biotechnology infrastructure Project. Maximum age limit not exceeding 35 years (40 years for Chhattisgarh bonafide resident). Assistant Grade -III Eligibility: Higher Secondary with 1 Year Diploma in Computer Application. Maximum age limit not exceeding 35 years (40 years for Chhattisgarh bonafide resident).

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested passport photo affixed on the application form Photo copies of all documents, testimonials, certificates, and reprints Proof of educational qualifications, degrees, mark sheets, and transcripts Caste certificate issued by competent authority (for reserved categories) Bonafide resident certificate of Chhattisgarh (for age relaxation and category benefits) Experience certificates

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a scorecard system for recruitment which includes points for educational qualifications, academic excellence, extra-curricular activities, research publications, experience, and a personal interview or computer skill test/typing test.

faq.question: Q1. Is this recruitment for a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment period will be maximum of 3 years or co-terminate with the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Relaxation in upper age limit for ST, SC, OBC, and women candidates (bonafide residents of Chhattisgarh only) will be provided as per C.G. Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q3. Who cannot apply for the CBPS Service?
faq.answer: Candidates having more than one wife and female candidate who had married with such a married man already having a wife alive, shall not be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit photo copies of all documents, testimonials, certificates, reprints, mark sheets, transcripts, and caste or bonafide certificates with the application.
